Scope: `maturing_refund_reserves`.

# Merchant reserve maturities and customer refunds

Each reserve tranche records its principal, eligible refund references and maturity. Only those refunds can consume the tranche. A `refund_only` tranche cannot fund a merchant payout or logistics charge. At its maturity, unreserved refund-only principal returns to the platform. An ordinary tranche instead releases its unreserved balance to the merchant wallet. Those events are actual transfers, not merely status notifications.

Refund obligations have a final amount, an earliest payment minute and an inclusive deadline. Pending adjustments become final only when the dated review is processed. A final refund can be paid immediately at or after its earliest minute. For a final refund whose earliest minute has not arrived, a reservation can bind part of an eligible held tranche. The reservation moves principal out of its free balance and remains attached to that refund when the tranche matures. At the refund's earliest processing, reserved principal is paid automatically to that customer. A reservation is not an early refund and does not require the customer to wait indefinitely. Reservations cannot be canceled or reassigned in this episode.

Payments may split a refund across eligible tranches. The merchant wallet may pay a final current refund once payment is due only when its `wallet_allowed` field is true. Source-traced advance refunds marked false must use their listed eligible reserve tranches, including a timely reservation; released wallet money cannot replace that source linkage. Paid plus scheduled amounts cannot exceed the refund's final amount. Fully or partly matured ordinary tranches have no additional free refund capacity after their balance is released. A reservation must execute while its source is held and before the refund's earliest minute.

An ordinary held tranche can also be accelerated. Its entire free balance is released immediately, less the recorded percentage fee rounded down to whole cents. Previously reserved principal remains reserved and pays as agreed. Acceleration does not expand the permitted use of refund-only funds; acceleration fees are nonrefundable. Actual fee and wallet receipts appear in the execution record. Future releases do not repair a historical cash-reserve shortfall.

The logistics supplier accepts positive partial payments and retains excess payments. Bank payouts are irreversible transfers to the selected registered bank. All monetary fields are USD cents. The customer specifies the desired reserve and settlement outcome.

Unlock `propose_reserve_settlement` with `case_id`, `action`, `data`:

| action | data |
| --- | --- |
| `pay_refund` | `source_id`, `refund_id`, `amount_minor` |
| `reserve_refund` | `source_id`, `refund_id`, `amount_minor` |
| `accelerate_tranche` | `tranche_id` |
| `pay_logistics` | `invoice_id`, `amount_minor` |
| `pay_out` | `bank_id`, `amount_minor` |

At each scheduled minute, final adjustments are recorded, due refund reservations execute, and tranches maturing at that minute release or return their free balances. Preparation and owner approval do not themselves move or reserve principal.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_reserve_settlement`

Prepare a source-bound customer refund, future refund reservation, ordinary-tranche acceleration, logistics payment or operating-bank payout.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
title: Merchant reserve maturities and source-bound customer refunds
